service.name: Equipment Request DB
service.description: Employees request equipment. Type a request number and press Load to open a saved request; Submit saves it to PostgreSQL (bawexternal).

steps.title: Requester
steps.intro: Enter the request number first. Press Load to open a request that was saved before.

fields.name: requestId
fields.label: Request Number
fields.help: The key of the saved row. Required.

confirmation.title: Request Submitted
confirmation.message: Your request was saved and sent for approval. Keep the reference number for follow-up.

process.name: Equipment Request DB Approval
process.description: Request equipment, then a manager approves it. The request is saved to PostgreSQL when it is submitted.
